_doc: Mia's hands and wrists as skinned vertices (each: [bone, weight, x, y, z in that bone's bind frame, metres]; the vertex is the weighted sum of the bones' model-frame transforms applied to these), and the film's phone (mph01): its box in its own frame (scaled as in the film) and where it rests on the charger in her model frame, for the live cut at lift 29 in / dock z 150.5. Taken from the render of the commons film (tools/experience/render-probe.cjs with a probe over the drawn SkinnedMesh: boneInverses x bindMatrix x position; every 2nd vertex dominated by a hand, finger or wrist-end forearm bone; branch director/polish-1124-commons, pass 3). Used by tests/people-place-test.mjs.
